properties.basis: 'nominally tributary to, but effectively independent of, the Anglo-Egyptian Sudan' (GHA VII p.283). West edge: Dar Masalit is 'bounded to the west by Wadai… to the east by the Fur', and Dar Tama 'has always been a bone of contention between the Sultans of Wadai and Darfur' (MacMichael I pp.85–86). So the core stops east of Dar Masalit/Tama, which should be drawn as a contested zone (geometry not yet drawn). VERIFY removed.

P.M. Holt & M.W. Daly, A History of the Sudan: From the Coming of Islam to the Present Day (2011)
R.S. O'Fahey & J.L. Spaulding, Kingdoms of the Sudan (1974)
